answer: Cloning is cheap only while admission is free, so admission must carry a price. Trust flows along the graph and thins with distance: a newcomer endorsed only by fresh keys carries no weight. A farm must recruit 7 real sponsors per alias or sit unendorsed, and tight clusters that vouch only for each other are detected and paid as one. Fresh keys with no genuine links stay distant no matter how many exist. The crystal test is the live device, the delta test is the locked stake, and the juniper test is the graded history no template can fake. The math, not the moderators, does the filtering.
